# Message reference

Contract 0.1. The contract between a fluidic UI app and its host.

## Messages

### `hello`

From the app, since 0.1. The app's first message, sent once, before any other.

| Field | Type | Since | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `versions` | `list<version>` | 0.1 | The contract versions the app speaks. |
| `app_id` | `string` | 0.1 | The app's id in reverse-DNS form, such as `dev.fluidic.notes`. It is a claim, not proof. |
| `sdk` | `sdk_info` | 0.1 | The SDK the app is built on, for diagnostics only. |

### `welcome`

From the host, since 0.1. The host's answer to hello, opening the session.

| Field | Type | Since | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `version` | 0.1 | The highest contract version both sides speak. |
| `session_id` | `u64` | 0.1 | The id the host gives the session. |
| `platform` | `platform_facts` | 0.1 | The facts about the platform the host runs on. |
| `limits` | `safety_limits` | 0.1 | The hard bounds the host refuses messages beyond. |

### `bye`

From either side, since 0.1. The last message of a session. Nothing after it is acted on.

| Field | Type | Since | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | `bye_reason` | 0.1 | Why the session ended. |

### `platform_facts` (struct)

Since 0.1. The set of facts about the platform the host runs on, which the app reads and does not negotiate. This version reports none.

No fields.

### `safety_limits` (struct)

Since 0.1. The set of hard bounds that protect the host. This version sets none.

No fields.
